title: Figure 4: Superconducting 'atomic' spaceship charged to GeV potential
description: Line diagram captioned 'Figure 4. Superconducting "Atomic" Spaceship, Positively Charged to GeV Potential, With Azimuthal Currents and Magnetic Mirror M By Magnetic Field B.' A cylindrical craft with labeled coils C, payload PL, biosshield BS, storage space SB and induction ring IR fires an ion beam I at a starburst fusion minibomb F, with electron flows e. It accompanies the section 'Delivery of a GeV Proton Beam Onto the Deuterium Fusion Explosive'.
